text:
elaine-cs: Hey team — FinCorp sent a bespoke security questionnaire asking for HSM attestation, KMS rotation/audit logs, audit log retention policy, and proof-of-deletion for temporary keys. They want a response by EOD Friday (48h). They also reported a 401 on /v1/embeddings earlier this week and want a repro/timeline. Need owners.

sam-eng: adding @security-ops and @oncall-eng. Do we have an HSM attestation PDF we can share? Is a redacted copy OK?

security-ops: We have vendor attestation + cert bundle. For KMS we can pull rotation events from prod-redwood-1. We should redact anything that looks like token material.

oncall-eng: I'll investigate the 401. Elaine, can you DM the request-id or the customer's curl snippet?

elaine-cs: Forwarding what they sent: stack trace says '401 unauthorized - token expired' and they included a curl with header X-Request-ID: fc-req-2026-11-03. I'll DM the full header.

oncall-eng: Found an entry in our logs matching that req id:

```
prod-ingest-01 | 2026-11-03T14:12:45Z | req_id=fc-req-2026-11-03 | path=/v1/embeddings | status=401 | auth_err=token_expired | user=fin_corp-org
prod-auth-02   | 2026-11-03T14:12:45Z | token_id=tok_ABC123 | issued_at=2026-10-03T14:12:45Z | rotated=false
```

sam-eng: That looks like a token older than 30 days. Our policy rotates/invalidates after 30d for those token types. We can provide rotation audit events.

security-ops: I'll prepare a KMS audit extract (rotate, disable, delete events) and an access-log excerpt that maps req_id -> auth result. Legal: @maria-legal, can we share key ARNs and timestamps but redact token values/PII?

maria-legal: We can share event timestamps and key ARNs. Do not include raw secret material or PII. Provide files as a redacted PDF/CSV and upload to secure share. Approving 48h turnaround.

elaine-cs: Customer also wants the retention policy text and where logs are stored. Are retention docs public or internal?

security-ops: Retention: default 365 days; enterprise add-on supports up to 7 years. Logs are stored in secure S3 (us-west-2) with lifecycle rules. We'll include the lifecycle policy snippet.

sam-eng: I'll assemble artifacts: 1) redacted HSM attestation PDF, 2) KMS rotation audit CSV, 3) access log excerpt mapping req_id, 4) S3 lifecycle snippet, 5) short cover note explaining how we correlate request-id to events. Target upload by Friday EOD.

oncall-eng: For repro, I confirmed locally: expired token -> 401. Steps to repro below.

```
# repro steps
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <expired_token>" -H "X-Request-ID: fc-req-2026-11-03" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings
# returns 401 Unauthorized, body: {"error":"token_expired","code":401}
# in logs: grep "fc-req-2026-11-03" /var/log/redwood/access-*.log
```

ops-bot: deploy-bot: New patch deployed to prod-auth-02 at 2026-11-04T02:00:00Z — no impact expected :rocket:

elaine-cs: Plan: I will send an initial packet (redacted attestation + policy summary) tomorrow COB to buy time for the full logs. If they insist on raw logs, escalate to SOC. @sam-eng @security-ops please upload to secure-share and paste link here when ready.

sam-eng: Uploading now to secure-share; link will be short-lived, I will paste when available.

security-ops: Uploaded KMS CSV and access-log excerpt to secure-share: https://secure.redwood.ai/share/XYZ123 (expires in 7d). Password sent to customer over verified channel. Repro confirmed as token expiry — no platform bug.

elaine-cs: Great. I'll close the loop and note billing concerns separately if they still see anomalies. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
